patch.value: Certify revision reconciliation on filesystem and native database backends

Reuse the resolution, relation and recovery corpus against filesystem and a native database without a local tracker. Synthetic REST only; independent backend authority and migration fidelity evidence.

Run two competing OS-process local writers, stale Azure revision, remote-success/local-failure replay, history-based settlement and unsupported capability refusal on both backends.; Verify authorization boundaries and lossless typed relation round trips, preserving provider-native reference names and explicit unknown capabilities.; Preserve existing fixture failure sensitivity with behavioral reverts and migration compatibility controls; certify no-git operation and do not infer native backend support from a CRUD projection.
